name: The Machine That Wouldn't Go Ghost

description.value:
Tier: Legendary

Ghost in the Machine was supposed to be a one-way door. You wedged it.

Requirement Drift 10 (Ghost in the Machine)

Duration constant

You retain full personal agency at all times — the GM narrates pressure and glitching, never puppeting, for you specifically. Every tech in Cyber City's heard the story by now: any NPC connected to Cyber City who hears your name reacts to it, unprompted, before they react to you.

cinderfall.incomplete: BAND-GAP for both the Drift-10 requirement gate and the agency-retention effect (nothing to retain agency from -- Ghost in the Machine isn't modeled); the reputation clause alone is narrative, but the card's mechanical core is a real, currently-unbuildable claim.
